svg.title: GitOps
svg.desc: GitOps. Git holds the desired state; an agent continuously reconciles the cluster to match it. Step 1, Push from CI, edit by hand: CI deploys with admin credentials; fixes typed into the cluster are lost at the next deploy. Step 2, Desired state lives in Git: A reviewed PR sets v43 and 4 replicas in Git; the agent inside the cluster pulls and applies it. Step 3, Drift is reconciled: Someone scales to 10 by hand: the agent reports OutOfSync and self-heals back to the 4 in Git. Step 4, Roll back and promote: v43 misbehaves: a revert commit brings v42 back. Promotion is a PR too; secrets stay encrypted.
